description: `coverageThreshold.global` under Jest 30.5.2 (T8.11, B23b): every metric asked for 100 while `src/grade.ts` leaves two branches, two statements, a function and their lines uncovered. Jest's `Jest: Coverage for <metric> (<n>%) does not meet "global" threshold (100%)` lines in its metric order (statements, branches, lines, functions), and exit code 1. Read by `provino`'s `jest-coverage-thresholds.test.ts`.
